name: Kawagoe (Mie, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kawagoe town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing the character 川.
history: Municipal flag of Kawagoe, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 October 1965.

features.role: Kawagoe town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing the character 川
